title: I used AI to reverse engineer a forgotten 2000s party game and rebuild it for the browser with online play
author: cuxes
selftext:
As a kid I played a lot of **Battle Painters**, a small Windows party game. Up to 4 players run around nonstop, can only steer left and right, and paint the floor with their trail. Whoever covers the most floor wins. It's simple and chaotic, and it's basically gone today.

So I tried to bring it back with AI doing most of the heavy lifting while I was making myself a cup of coffee. The result is **Canvas Clash**: [https://canvasclash.online](https://canvasclash.online)

I made the design calls (rule changes, team setup, menus), tested and kept pushing back when something felt off.

No graphics, sound effects, or music from the original game are used—but of course, the new assets are inspired by it.

I'd love feedback, especially on how the online play feels and on the music :)
